material_definitions: The sample Li1.3Fe0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 belongs to the NASICON-type phosphate family.
It is a part of the solid solution series Li(1+x)FexTi(2-x)(PO4)3.
In this material, Fe3+ is substituted for Ti4+ to increase Li+ content.
The crystal structure typically retains the R-3c space group of LiTi2(PO4)3.
The specific composition analyzed here corresponds to x = 0.3.

Arrhenius fitting of bulk and grain boundary regions for sample series LATP, LFTP, and LCTP.
LATP, LFTP, and LCTP likely correspond to lithium aluminum titanium phosphate, lithium iron titanium phosphate, and lithium chromium titanium phosphate ceramics.
Bulk contributions are represented by solid lines, while grain boundary (GB) contributions are shown with dashed lines.
The plot displays the product of conductivity and temperature (sigma T) against inverse temperature (1000/T).
